source: Book T: A Description of the Cards of the Tarot with their Attributions (Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn; S. L. MacGregor Mathers and Harriet Felkin, c. 1888). First printed openly in The Equinox, vol. I, 1912. Public domain.
notes: Card ids match deck.js and the image file numbers in cards/rws1909/.
Book T court names map one-to-one to Waite's: Knight = Knight (mounted 'King of the Spirits'), Queen = Queen, King = King ('Prince of the Chariot'), Knave = Page ('Princess').
Court spans run from 20° of one sign to 20° of the next, as Book T gives them. Princesses (Pages) and Aces hold no zodiac degrees.

Decan 1 = 0°–10°, decan 2 = 10°–20°, decan 3 = 20°–30° of the sign. Book T starts the decans at Saturn in the first decan of Leo (Cor Leonis); Mars rules both the last decan of Pisces and the first of Aries.
